name: kmp-standards
description: Engineering standards for Kotlin Multiplatform projects, published to npm so anyone can install them without a GitHub account.

plugins.name: kmp
plugins.description: Kotlin Multiplatform working standards: skills for adding a feature, changing a dependency, capturing an intent and writing a spec; a verifier subagent that runs both apps and reports what it saw; hooks that refuse to let the documents drift from the code; and adopt-standards, which installs the shared CLAUDE.md, rules, CI workflows, executable architecture rules and tools into a project.
